comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a connector terminal; record installs a split-core current sensor around the correct conductor.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate releases an internal tab with one blade and coordinated pulling; record opens, positions, orients, and snaps a hinged core and catch around a cable.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one terminal removed without collateral release or damage; record requires the sensor latched around only the line conductor with correct arrow direction and release.
comparison.reason: Both involve a latch, but one tests precision internal release and extraction while the other tests enclosure, orientation, and snap closure.
